workshoptitle: Build and Visualize SQL Property Graphs with Oracle Database and Linkurious Ogma

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Provision the Sandbox Environment
tutorials.description: Reserve the LiveLabs Sandbox and review the resources the Marketplace image provisions

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Connect to the Sandbox Environment
tutorials.description: Find your login information, open the remote desktop, and connect to the database

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Explore the Dataset
tutorials.description: Review the tables, keys, and relationships that become graph vertices and edges

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Create the SQL Property Graphs
tutorials.description: Define SQL property graphs on the relational tables and query them with GRAPH_TABLE

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Visualize the SQL Property Graphs with Linkurious Ogma
tutorials.description: Load graph query results into an Ogma web application and explore them interactively

tutorials.description: Solutions to common problems and directions for receiving live help
